name: Dialog
summary: Modal window that interrupts the flow for a focused task and traps focus until dismissed.

anatomy.description: Full-viewport backdrop in color.bg.scrim. Click-to-close is a choice, not a default; destructive confirms disable it.
The container. role="dialog" aria-modal="true". Prefer the native `<dialog>` with showModal(); it provides the top layer and inertness for free.
Labels the dialog via aria-labelledby. Required. States the task, not the product ("Rename project", not "Project").
Icon button with aria-label="Close". Omit for dialogs that must be answered (see alert-dialog).
The scroll region when content overflows; the header and footer stay fixed.
Actions, right-aligned on desktop, stacked on mobile; the primary action is last in DOM and visual order.
Behavioural part. Tab cycles inside the dialog while open.

variants.guidance: Width only. Height follows content up to a viewport-relative max, then the body scrolls.
Non-modal dialogs do not trap focus or use a scrim; they are for tool palettes, not tasks.

states.treatment: color.bg.surface, radius.surface, shadow.lg, z.modal; scrim at color.bg.scrim.
states.a11y: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby=<title id>. Everything behind it is inert.

states.treatment: Entry motion of motion.duration.base — fade + 2–4% scale, opacity-only under reduced motion.
states.a11y: Focus moves in on open; announcement is the title.

states.treatment: aria-busy on the body; footer actions keep width (see button loading).
Standard ring on every focusable inside; the dialog container itself is not focused unless nothing inside is.
none on the container; close-button and footer buttons own their own.
Dialogs are not disabled; actions inside may be.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape and scrim-click close it. False for confirms that need an explicit answer.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Where focus lands on open. Default is the first focusable element; for destructive confirms, the cancel button.

api.composition: Trigger, Title, Description, Body and Footer are composed as children so any content works and headings stay real headings. Size and modality are props because the system owns those sets. Do not add `confirmLabel` / `onConfirm` props; that is alert-dialog.

accessibility.name: aria-labelledby pointing at the title; aria-describedby at the description when present.

keyboard.action: Cycles focus within the dialog; never escapes to the page.

accessibility.focus: On open, focus moves to initialFocus, else the first focusable, else the container (tabindex=-1). On close, focus returns to the element that opened it. If that element is gone, focus the nearest logical ancestor.
accessibility.announcements: The title is announced on open by virtue of focus movement; no extra live region.

content.label: Title is the task as a verb phrase ("Rename project", "Invite teammates"). Footer buttons name the outcome ("Rename", "Send invites"), never "OK".
content.limits: One paragraph of description at most; longer content is a page, not a dialog.

use_when: A short task must be completed or abandoned before the user continues.
The user needs to confirm something with consequences (use alert-dialog for the destructive case).
avoid_when: The content is long or deserves its own URL — use a page.
You are stacking dialogs — flatten into steps or use a drawer.
The content is contextual and non-blocking — use a popover.
On mobile with a long form — use a full-screen or bottom drawer.

instead.when: Destructive confirmation requiring an explicit answer
Side panel with the page still usable
Small contextual content anchored to a trigger

local.title: Focus in, focus back
local.statement: Opening moves focus inside the dialog; closing returns focus to the trigger.

detect.runtime: document.activeElement is inside the dialog after open and equals the trigger after close.

local.fix: Use the native <dialog>.showModal() or the renderer's focus-scope primitive; store the trigger on open.

local.title: Background is inert
local.statement: While a modal dialog is open, content outside it is inert (not focusable, not clickable, hidden from assistive tech).

detect.runtime: Tab from the last focusable inside wraps to the first; outside elements are not reachable.

local.fix: Use <dialog>.showModal() or set `inert` on siblings of the portal root.

local.title: Never an unlabeled dialog
local.statement: Every dialog has a visible title referenced by aria-labelledby; a visually-hidden title is acceptable only for full-screen media viewers.

detect.static: role=dialog without aria-labelledby, or the referenced element is empty.

local.title: Destructive confirms default to safety
local.statement: When the primary action is destructive, initial focus and the default (Enter) action are the non-destructive option, and scrim-click does not close.

detect.runtime: On open, activeElement is the cancel button when a destructive button is present.

local.fix: Set initialFocus to the cancel action and dismissible=false.

resolved.title: Every state reaches the accessibility tree
resolved.statement: Every visible state has an ARIA expression or an explicit "none" in the spec; selected, expanded, invalid, busy and current are never visual-only.

detect.static: For each state the component declares, the matching attribute (aria-selected, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, aria-busy, aria-current, aria-checked) is present when the state is active.

resolved.fix: Set the attribute the APG pattern specifies; do not invent a new one.

resolved.title: Never remove focus without replacing it
resolved.statement: No `outline: none` / `outline-0` / `focus:outline-none` without a `:focus-visible` replacement that has ≥3:1 contrast against both the component and the page.

detect.static: Class or style removes outline and no focus-visible ring class/rule exists on the same element.
detect.runtime: Tab to the element; the focused and unfocused screenshots must differ at ≥3:1 along the element's edge.

resolved.fix: Use `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2` (or the binding's equivalent) and keep `:focus` untouched.

resolved.title: Native element first
resolved.statement: Prefer the native element (button, a, select, details, input) until a product requirement makes it impossible; a div or span with a click handler and a role is a defect unless the spec names an exception.

detect.static: div|span with onClick/onKeyDown and no native equivalent in the subtree.

resolved.fix: Replace with the native element; keep the styling.

resolved.title: Every control has an accessible name
resolved.statement: Every interactive element has an accessible name from content, a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; placeholder text and title attributes do not count.

detect.static: Compute the accessible name per accname 1.2; empty is a failure.

resolved.fix: Add visible text, a <label>, or aria-label for icon-only controls.

resolved.title: No literal values
resolved.statement: Component styles read token roles only, through the binding's custom properties; no literal colours, radii, shadows, durations or z-indexes (`#7c3aed`, `oklch(…)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `z-index: 50`, `300ms`).
resolved.rationale: Tokens are the primer; the component is the finish. A literal value breaks every theme at once.

detect.static: A declaration on a component part sets colour, radius, shadow, duration or z-index to anything other than `var(--lq-…)` (or a utility class that does not resolve to a role through the binding).

resolved.fix: Replace with the role's custom property from the binding (see spec/bindings/html.yaml).

resolved.title: Parts are addressable
resolved.statement: Every anatomy part renders with `data-slot="<part>"` so docs, tests and the grader can target it without classes.

detect.static: For each anatomy part marked required, an element with that data-slot exists.

resolved.fix: Add data-slot to the part's root element.

resolved.title: Reduced motion is honoured
resolved.statement: Any transition longer than 150 ms or any looping animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` branch that removes movement (opacity-only is fine).

detect.static: Animation/transition utilities present without a motion-reduce: variant or media query.
detect.runtime: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion and assert no transform-based animation is running.

resolved.fix: Add `motion-reduce:transition-none` / `motion-reduce:animate-none` or an equivalent media query.

resolved.title: No stacked modals
resolved.statement: A modal dialog never opens another modal dialog; use a step inside the same dialog, a drawer, or a non-modal popover.

detect.runtime: Two elements with role=dialog and aria-modal=true are open at once.

resolved.fix: Flatten into a stepper inside one dialog, or convert the inner one to non-modal.

resolved.title: Labels are verb-first and specific
resolved.statement: Action labels start with a verb and name the object ("Save changes", "Delete 3 files"); never "OK", "Yes", "Submit" or "Click here" when a specific label is possible.

detect.static: Button/menu-item text matches a stoplist or lacks a verb.

resolved.fix: Rewrite as verb + object, sentence case, ≤3 words where possible.

grading.notes: A dialog defect blocks the whole screen, so it is weighted above an atom.
